chorusOfHavoc.name: Chorus of Havoc (The Hubac Twins Domain)
chorusOfHavoc.description: The Compagnie's sword and spear, the Hubac Twins, are at the height of their strength. It is time to take the fight to them and halt their advance.

theGloriousPhoenix.name: The Glorious Phoenix (Li Tian Ning Domain)

undyingMaw.name: Undying Maw (Risen Mega Lestari)
undyingMaw.description: There have been sightings of Lestari in these waters. But something is off about the beast, as though it has been tainted by Vikram's influence.

fangsOfTheFara.name: Fangs of the Fara (Tangena Rabe)
fangsOfTheFara.description: Captain Tangena Rabe is the Fara's latest deadly weapon against their sworn enemy, the Sea People.

hunterHunted.name: Hunter, Hunted (Joka Kubwa)
hunterHunted.description: Joka Kubwa, a zealous Ungwanan officer, seeks to scour the coast of all outside influence, be it French or pirate.

watchTheThrone.name: Watch the Throne (Ah Pak)
watchTheThrone.description: The Eels corsair known as Ah Pak has arrived in the Open Seas to establish himself as the Kingpin of Kingpins. Show him who truly rules the waves.

aTreacherousTurn.name: A Treacherous Turn (Dian Sinaga)
aTreacherousTurn.description: Captain Dian Sinaga seeks to betray her Rempah comrades. Turn the tables on the traitor and claim a reward.

aShowOfStrength.name: A Show of Strength
aShowOfStrength.description: Incrensed by reports of rebel activity, the DMC has sent Dirk Ankeren, a brutal enforcer, to stake their claim.

fromTheDeep.name: From the Deep (Kuharibu)
fromTheDeep.description: In the Open Seas, numerous ships have gone missing. Survivors whisper of an "ancient terror", something monstrous emerging from the deep, taking ships whole.

theVanishing.name: The Vanishing (Lestari)
theVanishing.description: A massive shark-like creature stalks the seas in search of prey, threatening trade and leaving seafarers terrified

silentDeath.name: Silent Death (Mega Lestari Domain)
silentDeath.description: A shadow has been spotted lurking in the waters below, a prowling threat from the depths...

bloodDrunk.name: Blood Drunk (Galvin Roche)
bloodDrunk.description: Captain Galvin Roche is on a drunken spree of murder and mayhem against the Ungwana. Sober him up with cannon-fire and reap the rewards.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.description: A shadow has been spotted lurking in the waters below, a prowling threat from the depths...

jawsOfRetribution.name: Jaws of Retribution (Zamaharibu Domain)
jawsOfRetribution.description: Scores of ships in the region have been decimated by an unknown foe

megafortWolvenhol.name: Megafort Wolvenhol
megafortWolvenhol.description: Band with 5 other Captains to steal a hoard of ascended materials held within the Megafort

heraldsOfTheAbyss.name: Heralds of the Abyss
heraldsOfTheAbyss.description: Shadows from beyond lurk at the edge of reality. Draw forth the Abyssal Fleet and banish them from this realm.

abyssalEnvoy.name: Abyssal Envoy
abyssalEnvoy.description: A ghostly dread that whispers ruin emerges from the splintering tides. A cursed envoy of horrors to come.

gloryAdornedResynced.name: Glory Adorned: Resynced
gloryAdornedResynced.description: Look out for merchant convoys donning unique Cosmetics. Defeat them and stand to claim those cosmetics for your ship!
